easy: The language that people in Armenia speak.

easy: In a house or building, not outside.

easy: Growing bigger as more is added.

ex.ko: 우리는 미나가 달리기에서 이긴 것을 축하했다.

easy: Moving slowly on your hands and knees.

easy: Thinking people are selfish and never good.

easy: An event held to collect money for a good cause.

easy: A piece of clothing.

easy: Made of simple shapes like circles and squares.

easy: To smile big and show your teeth.

ex.ko: 그는 생일 케이크를 보고 활짝 웃었다.

easy: To sing a tune with your lips closed.

easy: Not thinking you are better than other people.

easy: Wood from trees cut into boards for building.

easy: A very large crowd of people.

easy: A person or thing that gives an artist ideas.

easy: To think deeply and slowly about something.

ex.en: I sat by the window and mused about my summer trip.
ex.ko: 나는 창가에 앉아 여름 여행을 곰곰이 생각했다.

easy: A woman paid to take care of children.

ex.en: Our nanny picks us up after school.
ex.ko: 보모 아주머니가 방과 후에 우리를 데리러 오신다.

easy: A female goat.

ex.en: The nanny goat fed her baby goat milk.
ex.ko: 암염소가 새끼 염소에게 젖을 먹였다.

easy: One more than eighteen.

ex.en: There are nineteen kids in my class.
ex.ko: 우리 반에는 열아홉 명의 아이들이 있다.

easy: The number 19.

ex.en: My grandpa's house number is nineteen.
ex.ko: 할아버지 댁 번지수는 열아홉이다.

easy: Having to do with the path something takes around a planet or star.

ex.en: The moon's orbital path goes around Earth.
ex.ko: 달의 궤도는 지구 둘레를 돈다.

easy: Leaving a place.

ex.en: Outgoing trains leave from track two.
ex.ko: 떠나는 기차는 2번 선로에서 출발한다.

easy: About to leave a job and be replaced.

ex.en: Our outgoing principal said goodbye to everyone.
ex.ko: 물러나시는 교장 선생님이 모두에게 작별 인사를 하셨다.

easy: Checking and fixing a car or machine.

ex.en: Dad took the car in for an overhaul.
ex.ko: 아빠는 차를 정비받으러 가져가셨다.

easy: From time to time, not all the time.

ex.en: I check the mailbox periodically.
ex.ko: 나는 가끔 우편함을 확인한다.
